Fate

Kate Komuntale (Nantongo Justine), a high-flying Kampala Corporate Executive in her thirties, has everything except a family: a husband and a child.

2006

  • movie
  • Drama

Overview

Kate Komuntale (Nantongo Justine), a high-flying Kampala Corporate Executive in her thirties, has everything except a family: a husband and a child. Society builds pressure on her to marry so as to complete her success. In that quagmire, Ken Bagonza (Allie Mutaka), a smooth-talking intelligence officer, breezes into the scene and easily sweeps Kate off her feet and up to the altar. But Ken has a sinister agenda… Bliss turns to hell. Kate has to dig deeper into her inner reservoir of strength to survive Ken’s crazy womanising, wild temper and, above all, singly parent ‘sensitive’ Ivan … Is it fate or choice?
